essence: A five-limbed sub-pedestal should be placed below the lotus base.
The neck of the sub-pedestal is defined as four parts out of ten.
Two great projections should be made in the five-limbed sub-pedestal.
The components are arranged in sequence by quarter parts, two units, and two quarter parts.
The elements occur in sequence as cane-lotus, fillet, lotus, projection, and cane.
